title: Joel And I — EN/ES/FR — Chas Lessons #3 (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar Spanish French language learning dry wit deadpan 104bpm upright bass brushed snare trilingual grammar lesson character portrait warm
lyrics:
[Verse 1 - English]
Swan River. Late afternoon.
Corey said "me and Joel are going down."
Chas waited a half-beat. Then:
"Oh — you mean Joel and I."
Not a lecture. Just the correction. Clean.

[Verse 2 - Spanish, with English translations]
"Joel y yo" — no "yo y Joel" (Joel and I — not I and Joel)
Yo siempre va al final (I always goes last)
Quita el otro nombre, lee lo que queda (Remove the other name, read what's left)
"Yo voy al agua" — correcto (I am going to the water — correct)
"Me voy al agua" — equivocado (Me am going — wrong)
Entonces es Joel y yo (So it's Joel and I)
El orden de tus palabras (The order of your words)
Es el orden de tus prioridades (Is the order of your priorities)
Ponte al último en el lenguaje (Put yourself last in language)
Y algo cambia (And something shifts)

[Chorus - French, with English translations]
"Joël et moi" — pas "moi et Joël" (Joel and I — not me and Joel)
Le moi va toujours à la fin (The I always goes last)
Retire l'autre nom, lis ce qui reste (Remove the other name, read what's left)
"Je vais à l'eau" — correct (I am going to the water — correct)
"Moi vais à l'eau" — faux (Me am going — wrong)
Donc c'est Joël et moi (So it's Joel and I)
L'ordre de tes mots (The order of your words)
Est l'ordre de tes priorités (Is the order of your priorities)
Mets-toi en dernier dans le langage (Put yourself last in language)
Et quelque chose change (And something shifts)

[Bridge - all three]
English: Language is character in advance
Spanish: El lenguaje es carácter por adelantado (Language is character in advance)
French: Le langage est le caractère en avance (Language is character in advance)

[Outro - all three]
English: Joel and I — Swan River — one sentence — permanent
Spanish: Joel y yo — Río Swan — una frase — permanente (Joel and I — Swan River — one sentence — permanent)
French: Joël et moi — Swan River — une phrase — permanente (Joel and I — Swan River — one sentence — permanent)
